term.claim: BTC/USD closes at or above $100,000 before the window end

elements.q: Did BTC/USD close at or above $100,000 at any point before the window end?

sources.text: CoinDesk reported on November 3, 2026 that bitcoin (BTC/USD) closed the trading day at $100,432, the first daily close above the $100,000 threshold this cycle.
Reuters confirmed bitcoin ended the November 3, 2026 session at just over $100,000, trading as high as $100,900 before settling near $100,400.
